scenarios.title: Normal operations
scenarios.story: A normal afternoon: aircraft taxiing, service vehicles at the stands. Everything trusted.

scenarios.title: Phantom runway incursion
scenarios.story: A tractor's GPS suddenly puts it on Runway 16R/34L. A runway camera sees an empty runway: the position is wrong, not the tractor.

scenarios.title: Real runway incursion
scenarios.story: A fuel truck really drives onto Runway 16L/34R. The data is sound, so the alert says act now, and a runway camera confirms it.

scenarios.title: Apron interference
scenarios.story: Five vehicles on the apron near Boarding Area E61-A83 lose GNSS at the same moment. One area alert instead of five, and a mast camera shows the vehicles are where they should be.

scenarios.title: Jammer in a passing car
scenarios.story: A car with a cheap GPS jammer drives past the aprons. The degraded area moves with it, vehicles are warned before they enter, and security gets a place to look.

scenarios.title: Approach spoofing
scenarios.story: Three arriving aircraft suddenly report positions on the same small circle far from the runway: the signature of GNSS spoofing seen over the Baltic and Eastern Mediterranean.

scenarios.title: Multipath near the terminal
scenarios.story: Next to Terminal 3 the satellite signals bounce off the facade. Vehicles there get less accurate positions: the system lowers trust without raising a false alarm.

scenarios.title: Frozen receiver at night
scenarios.story: At night a bus's receiver freezes: same position, but still reporting 30 km/h. The nearest gate camera has no infrared, so the system says plainly that it can't confirm.

scenarios.title: Space weather in fog
scenarios.story: A burst of solar activity lowers GNSS accuracy everywhere at once, with no single source. In the morning fog the cameras can't help either.

scenarios.title: Speeding on the apron
scenarios.story: A catering truck crosses the apron at 55 km/h. The position is trustworthy and the behaviour is wrong: a real event, confirmed by an apron camera.
